name: Acqualina Resort
insider_take: This oceanfront sanctuary sits on 4.5 pristine acres where Mediterranean elegance meets Miami glamour, featuring three pools cascading toward the Atlantic and a private beach that feels worlds away from South Beach's party scene.
whats_special: Acqualina is home to the largest spa in Miami Beach at 20,000 square feet, plus the only beachfront restaurant by Michelin-starred chef Kostantinos Lazarakis. The resort's marine biology program offers guests unique sea turtle nesting experiences during season, while the stunning mosaic-tiled pools are adorned with over 2 million hand-laid tiles imported from Italy.
pro_tip: Book a suite on floors 15+ for unobstructed ocean views and request the complimentary Rolls-Royce house car service to Bal Harbour Shops - it's just a 5-minute ride to some of the world's most exclusive boutiques.
dont_miss: The Sunday Jazz Brunch at AQ Chop House with live music and ocean views, plus the resort's exclusive partnership with nearby Haulover Inlet for deep-sea fishing excursions. During turtle season (May-October), join the nighttime turtle walks to witness loggerhead nesting on the resort's protected beach.
pros: Oceanfront luxury resort with pristine beachfront access
Multiple award-winning restaurants and dining experiences
Spacious suites and residences with premium amenities
cons: Limited availability due to high demand
